title: Topic 8: Time, Days & Dates - Speaking
description: Recorded speaking task, teacher-graded against a 4-criterion rubric.
canDoStatement: Tell the time, say days and months, give simple dates

speakingTask.speakingPrompt:
Record yourself. Talk about your week.
Say 4 things:
1. What day is it today? (Today is...)
2. One thing you do + day + time
(I study English on Monday at eight o'clock.)
3. Your happy day of the week + one reason
(Sunday! I sleep...)
4. Your birthday month (My birthday is in...)

Tip: Say the day and time TOGETHER: on Monday AT eight.
